verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
How long until You come to Jerusalem
How long until You come to Jerusalem

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Who is like Him? Lion and the Lamb
Seated on the throne
Mountains bow down, every ocean roars
To the Lord of hosts

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Praise Adonai
From the rising of the sun
To the end of every day
Praise Adonai
All the nations of the earth
All the angels and the saints sing praise

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
This is the heartbeat of heaven
This is the cry of the nations
We hear the Spirit, we are the bride
Saying, "Come, Lord Jesus"
